comment: Published views are the write-audit-publish switch: a view shows a gate release at once with no dbt run
The data-health marts read the gate audit log which is written after dbt runs: views are always current
The release filter: every published view joins it by design
Quality lane: QA models read staging directly to see what the marts filter out
Grades the QA layer against generator ground truth: the answer key is not pipeline input so it has no staging model
Ground truth documented for the load checks in ingestion/04_verify_load.sql: only defect_manifest is graded inside dbt
Static ground truth loaded once: freshness has no meaning
